Filmmaker Cullen Hoback joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 1710. Hoback directed Into the Storm, the documentary series that chased the people behind QAnon, the conspiracy movement that ate the internet. His work took him inside the forums where the myth was built.

He tells Rogan what he found: the posters, the site owners, and his case for who wrote as Q. Rogan asks how a joke-board riddle grew into a political force. The episode is a long-form report from the man who filmed the hunt, full of odd characters and a sober ending about belief online.
